prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1236; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a sideswipe collision that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. Insured reports the other vehicle's driver moved into the lane without signaling. Both drivers gave consistent accounts at the scene. Police report requested. Initial contact made with the claimant, who reports neck and back strain and has not retained an attorney.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant regarding symptoms. Claimant describes neck stiffness and lower back soreness that began within hours of the impact. Claimant has not yet sought medical treatment but plans to see a physician. Advised claimant of the medical payments coverage available under the policy and provided the list of in-network providers.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by both parties. Damage to the rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle and the front passenger side of the claimant vehicle is consistent with a sideswipe. No independent witnesses identified at this time. Scene diagram from the police report indicates both vehicles were traveling in the same direction.

Entry 4: Claimant confirmed she is not represented by counsel. Explained the claims process, including the timeline for repair estimates and how bodily injury evaluation works. Claimant provided medical records from her initial urgent care visit, which document cervical and lumbar strain with a recommendation for physical therapy. Treatment is ongoing.

Entry 5: Liability review in progress. Based on the police report, statements, and physical damage evidence, liability appears to lean toward the other driver's unsafe lane change, pending receipt of their recorded statement. Bodily injury reserve set based on current treatment plan. Will follow up with claimant after physical therapy evaluation is completed.
